A C planar field has scalar curl 2 on a neighborhood of the closed annulus 1 ≤ x + y ≤ 4.
Its counterclockwise circulation around the outer circle is 10π. What is its counterclockwise
circulation around the inner circle?
(A) −4π (B) 4π (C) 6π (D) 10π (E) 16π

solution.text:
Positive orientation of the entire annular boundary uses the outer circle counterclockwise
and the inner circle clockwise. Thus Green gives 10π − I = 2(4π − π) = 6π, so I = 4π.
Smoothness has only been assumed near the annulus; applying the theorem to the filled
disk would require information not given.

solution.text:
The connector contributions cancel because their orientations are opposite. The two circle
contributions are their signed areas, π and −4π, for a total of −3π. The walk is not a
simple positively oriented boundary of the union, whose ordinary area is 5π; apply the area
identity to the separate simple loops.
